title: FLUKE: A Linguistically-Driven and Task-Agnostic Framework for Robustness Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Changing proper nouns to names and locations specific to underrepresented regions (e.g., Africa, Middle East, Southeast Asia) and replacing common nouns with culturally relevant entities.
Replacing words with their old-fashioned variants to evaluate if model performance is affected by older linguistic styles.
Artificially shortening or lengthening the input text to test if the model exploits sentence length as a predictive data artifact.
Rewriting sentences from standard American or British English into specific dialects (e.g., Singaporean creole English/Singlish) and highly casual styles to evaluate robustness to language varieties.
